Livelihood targets Suppliers representing 50% of our procurement spend to sign the Living Wage Promise by 2026 A living wage promise is a commitment made by a supplier to progress towards paying a living wage to workers in their own business operations, either through signing a Living Wage Special Terms Contract (STC) with Unilever or by signing Unilever’s Living Wage Promise document.
